system.description:
Action
Reaction · when a creature begins falling
SP
1
Attribute
Automatic
Range
One visible creature within 6 squares
Duration
Until it lands, up to 1 minute

A cushion of air slows the descent to 2 squares each round. The recipient lands upright and unharmed from this fall if the destination supports it.
